description: This file handles processing of messages and reactions for the BlueBubbles integration, including message normalization, history management, media handling, and reaction events.

methods.name: queryBlueBubblesChats
methods.description: Queries BlueBubbles chats with pagination and optional private network allowance.

methods.name: fetchBlueBubblesParticipantsForInboundMessage
methods.description: Fetches participants for a specific chat based on chat GUID, ID, or identifier.

methods.name: isBlueBubblesSelfChatMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message is a self-chat message based on sender handle and chat context.

methods.name: prunePendingOutboundMessageIds
methods.description: Removes expired pending outbound message IDs based on TTL.

methods.name: rememberPendingOutboundMessageId
methods.description: Stores a pending outbound message ID with associated metadata.

methods.name: forgetPendingOutboundMessageId
methods.description: Removes a specific pending outbound message ID.

methods.name: chatsMatch
methods.description: Checks if two chat identifiers (GUID, ID, or handle) match.

methods.name: consumePendingOutboundMessageId
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a matching pending outbound message ID based on message body.

methods.name: logGroupAllowlistHint
methods.description: Logs hints for group message allowlist configuration.

methods.name: resolveBlueBubblesAckReaction
methods.description: Resolves the acknowledgment reaction emoji, with fallback and logging for unsupported reactions.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Main function to process incoming messages, handle normalization, media, history, permissions, and dispatch replies.

methods.name: processReaction
methods.description: Handles processing of reaction events, including permission checks and event enqueuing.
